subject: Social Media
title: The Social Validation Loop
description: A quick, practical guide to The Social Validation Loop.

hook.text: Post. Wait for likes. Feel good or bad based on the count. Post again to chase the high. Repeat forever.

buildup.text: The validation loop ties self-worth to external feedback. Your mood now depends on strangers' thumbs.

discovery.text: MRI studies show social validation activates the same brain regions as monetary reward. Likes are literally currency.

twist.text: Withholding validation hurts more than never receiving it. Getting 10 likes after 100 feels like rejection.

climax.text: The loop escalates. Creators post more provocative content to maintain approval. The audience demands more.

punchline.text: The loop feels like connection. It's extraction.

quiz.question: What do MRI studies show about social media likes?
options: They activate the same brain areas as monetary reward
